# RUTA34 Telecom — eSIM for Latin American Travelers

## What We Do

RUTA34 sells prepaid eSIMs for travelers from Latin America (Argentina, Brazil,
Chile, Uruguay) visiting Spain and the rest of Europe. The customer buys online,
receives a QR code by email, installs it on a compatible phone, and arrives in
Europe already connected.

## Key Facts

- **Company:** RUTA34 TELECOM, S.L. (registered in Spain)
- **Primary market:** Latin American travelers
- **Service area:** Spain plus the 30 European countries included in the plan
- **Network:** certified Spanish telecommunications network, 4G/5G coverage
- **Delivery method:** QR code sent by email (no app required)
- **Languages:** Spanish (ES), Portuguese (PT)

## Pricing

**This file intentionally contains no prices or data allowances.** The catalog is
managed in an admin panel and any hand-written copy goes stale. The only
up-to-date source is the website:

- https://www.esimruta34.com/es
- https://www.esimruta34.com/pt

Plans are published there with schema.org `Product` structured data.

## Plan Type

Every plan currently sold in the store is the same product in different sizes:

- Spanish phone number included
- Unlimited calls and SMS **within Spain**; international call minutes vary by
  destination and plan
- 4G/5G data in Spain and in the 30 included European countries
- 28 days of service
- One-time payment in USD, taxes included, **no auto-renewal**

There is no data-only product in the store, and there are no data or day top-ups.
If the trip runs longer, the customer buys another plan.

## How the Data Allowance Works

Each plan has **one** data allowance plus a **sub-cap** on how much of it can be
spent outside Spain:

- `data_gb` — the **total** allowance of the plan
- `eu_data_gb` — the maximum share of **that same** allowance usable outside
  Spain, in the included countries

**They are not additive.** A plan with 270 GB total and a 23 GB sub-cap is 270 GB
in total, of which at most 23 GB can be used outside Spain — not 293 GB.

## When the 28 Days Start

The 28 days start **when RUTA34 activates the eSIM and sends the QR code**, not
when the customer installs it.

- The customer can pick immediate activation or **schedule a date up to 12 months
  after purchase**.
- The QR is emailed within business hours, within 2 hours maximum. Orders placed
  outside business hours are processed at the start of the next business period.

## Data Roaming

- **On the RUTA34 eSIM:** data roaming must be **switched on** when outside Spain,
  in the included countries. It is a Spanish line and roams outside Spain.
- **On the customer's home SIM:** we recommend keeping data roaming **off** to
  avoid unexpected charges from their own carrier.

## Payment

Credit or debit card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) via **Stripe**. Prices
are shown in USD including applicable taxes. RUTA34 does not store card data.

## Refunds

Full refund within **24 hours of purchase**, provided the QR code has **not been
installed** on any device. Once the eSIM is installed no refund applies, since the
profile has already been activated on the device.

Full terms: https://www.esimruta34.com/es/terminos

## Compatibility

The device must support eSIM and must **not be carrier-locked**. Verifying this is
the customer's responsibility before purchase.

General reference: iPhone XS / XR (2018) and newer · Samsung Galaxy S20 and newer ·
Google Pixel 3 and newer, plus models from Motorola, Xiaomi, Oppo, Huawei, Sony,
Nokia, Honor, TCL, ZTE, Vivo, Realme, Nothing and Crosscall. Phones only — tablets
are not covered.

The up-to-date, model-by-model checker is at
https://www.esimruta34.com/es/compatibility

## Customer Accounts

**There is no customer account or dashboard.** The QR code and order updates are
delivered by email; order questions are handled over WhatsApp using the order
reference.
